auth_back_to_sign_in: A link under the forgot-password form, after "Remembered your password?": back to the sign-in page.
auth_change_email_bad_link: The link from the email that confirms a new address is missing a part: it can't be used.
auth_change_email_busy: Beside a spinner while the link from the email that confirms a new address is checked.
auth_change_email_done_title: Heading: the account's email address is now the new one.
auth_change_email_failed_title: Heading over what went wrong when changing the account's email address.
auth_confirm_password_label: [short] A field's label: the password typed a second time, to check it. Confirm is an adjective here (the confirmation of the password), not a button.
auth_display_name_label: [short] Sign-up field's label: the name shown to others, which may stay empty. The username is a separate field.
auth_display_name_placeholder: [short] Grey example text inside the empty display-name field on sign-up, in a half-width column. Lowercase on purpose.
auth_email_label: [short] A field's label: the account's email address.
auth_email_placeholder: Grey example inside the empty email field on sign-in, sign-up and the forgot-password page. Keep it a well-formed address at example.com (a domain reserved for examples); the part before @ may use your language's word, e.g. du@example.com.
auth_forgot_busy: [short] The forgot-password page's button while its request is being sent.
auth_forgot_link: [short] A link beside the password field's label on sign-in: opens the page that sends a reset email.
auth_forgot_remembered: Under the forgot-password form, followed by the link "Back to sign in".
auth_forgot_sent: Shown after a reset email is asked for. It never says whether the account exists, on purpose.
auth_forgot_title: Heading of the page that sends a password reset email.
auth_go_to_duvet: [short] A button after an email link worked: opens the app. Duvet is the app's name.
auth_go_to_sign_in: [short] A button that opens the sign-in page.
auth_new_password_label: [short] A field's label on the reset-password page: the password the account will have.
auth_password_hide: Name of the eye button at the end of a password field while the password is shown: a press hides it again.
auth_password_label: [short] A field's label on sign-in: the account's password.
auth_password_show: Name of the eye button at the end of a password field: a press shows what was typed.
auth_passwords_differ: Under the second password field when the two passwords typed aren't the same.
auth_reset_busy: Beside a spinner while the new password is saved.
auth_reset_confirm_placeholder: Grey hint inside the empty second password field on the reset-password page.
auth_reset_done_title: Heading: the password was reset (a past participle, not a button).
auth_reset_failed_title: Heading over what went wrong when resetting the password.
auth_reset_no_token: The reset link opened has no code in it, so the password can't be reset. A token is the code in the link.
auth_reset_password_placeholder: Grey hint inside the empty new-password field. # is the shortest length a password may have (8).
auth_session_not_renewed: An error a request in a second window (Settings, a Space's settings) can show: the app's main window keeps the sign-in fresh, and it didn't in time. Nobody is signed out.
auth_sign_in: [short] A button or link: sign in to an account (a verb).
auth_sign_in_busy: [short] The sign-in button while it's being sent.
auth_sign_in_create_account: A link under the sign-in form, after "New to Duvet?": opens sign-up.
auth_sign_in_lead: Under the sign-in page's heading. Duvet is the app's name.
auth_sign_in_missing_both: Shown when sign-in is pressed with both fields empty.
auth_sign_in_missing_email: Shown when sign-in is pressed without an email address.
auth_sign_in_missing_password: Shown when sign-in is pressed without a password.
auth_sign_in_new: Under the sign-in form, followed by the link "Create an account". Duvet is the app's name.
auth_sign_in_password_placeholder: Grey hint inside the empty password field on sign-in.
auth_sign_up_busy: [short] The sign-up button while the account is being made.
auth_sign_up_confirm_placeholder: [short] Grey hint inside the empty second password field on sign-up, in a half-width column: type the same password again. Lowercase on purpose.
auth_sign_up_have_account: Under the sign-up form, followed by the link "Sign in".
auth_sign_up_lead: Under the sign-up page's heading. It goes on from the tagline "a cozy place to talk" (Duvet's), so it starts in lowercase.
auth_sign_up_password_label: [short] Sign-up field's label, in a half-width column. # is the shortest length a password may have (8).
auth_sign_up_password_placeholder: [short] Grey hint inside the empty password field on sign-up: a password of # characters or more. # is the shortest length (8).
auth_tagline: Duvet's tagline, under its name beside the sign-in pages. Lowercase on purpose.
auth_terms_agree: Beside the checkbox on sign-up. <terms>…</terms> is a link that opens the terms: keep the tags around the words that name them.
auth_terms_title: Heading of the sheet that shows the terms of use.
auth_username_hint: Under the username field on sign-up: the characters a username may have (letters, digits, dots and underscores) and its length, 2 to 32. People mention someone with @username.
auth_username_label: [short] Sign-up field's label, in a half-width column beside the display name: the unique name people mention with @username. Not the display name.
auth_username_placeholder: [short] Grey example text inside the empty username field on sign-up, in a half-width column. Lowercase on purpose.
auth_verify_busy: Beside a spinner while the link from the email that confirms the account's address is checked.
auth_verify_done_title: Heading: the account's email address is confirmed.
auth_verify_failed_title: Heading over what went wrong when confirming the account's email address.
auth_verify_no_token: The confirmation link opened has no code in it. A token is the code in the link.
chat_add_files: [short] An item of the message box's + menu. A verb.
chat_add_gif: [short] An item of the message box's + menu: opens the GIFs.
chat_add_menu: The + button of the message box, and its menu.
chat_add_sticker: [short] An item of the message box's + menu: opens the stickers.
chat_attachment_deleted: In place of a message's file that's gone.
chat_author_unknown: Who sent a voice note or a sound, when the message doesn't say: shown by the player.
chat_bot_thinking: In place of a bot's answer while it prepares it, with dots after it. {name} is the bot's name.
chat_call_duration_hours: How long a call lasted, in whole hours. Fills {duration} in the call notices (chat_call_notice_*).
chat_call_duration_hours_minutes: How long a call lasted, in hours and minutes. Fills {duration} in the call notices (chat_call_notice_*).
chat_call_duration_minutes: How long a call lasted, under an hour. Fills {duration} in the call notices (chat_call_notice_*).
chat_call_duration_seconds: How long a call lasted, under a minute. Fills {duration} in the call notices (chat_call_notice_*).
chat_call_notice_missed: A notice in a group, where a call the reader wasn't in ended. {name} is who called (bold); {duration} is how long it lasted (chat_call_duration_*).
chat_call_notice_missed_unanswered: A notice in a direct message or group: a call that rang the reader, which nobody joined. {name} is who called (bold).
chat_call_notice_started: A notice in a direct message or group, where a call ended. {name} is who called (drawn in bold, between and ); {duration} is how long it lasted, e.g. 5 minutes (chat_call_duration_*).
chat_call_notice_unanswered: A notice in a group, of a call from before the reader joined it, which nobody joined. {name} is who called (bold).
chat_call_notice_you_started: A notice in a direct message or group, where the reader's own call ended. {duration} is how long it lasted, e.g. 5 minutes (chat_call_duration_*).
chat_call_notice_you_unanswered: A notice in a direct message or group: the reader's own call, which nobody joined.
chat_code_copy: [short] The button on a block of code in a message. A verb.
chat_command_cancel: Read by screen readers: the × on the bot command being written in the message box.
chat_command_option_false: [short] One of the two choices of a bot command's yes-or-no option (false).
chat_command_option_integer: Under a bot's command in the message box. {option} is the name of the command's option, as the bot wrote it.
chat_command_option_max: Under a bot's command in the message box. {option} is the name of the command's option; {max} is the largest number it takes.
chat_command_option_max_length: Under a bot's command in the message box. {option} is the name of the command's option; {count} is how many characters it takes at most. English keeps "characters" for 1; give your language its forms.
chat_command_option_min: Under a bot's command in the message box. {option} is the name of the command's option; {min} is the smallest number it takes.
chat_command_option_min_length: Under a bot's command in the message box. {option} is the name of the command's option; {count} is how many characters it needs at least. English keeps "characters" for 1; give your language its forms.
chat_command_option_number: Under a bot's command in the message box. {option} is the name of the command's option, as the bot wrote it.
chat_command_option_required: Under a bot's command in the message box, when it can't be sent. {option} is the name of the command's option, as the bot wrote it (e.g. text).
chat_command_option_true: [short] One of the two choices of a bot command's yes-or-no option (true).
chat_commands_label: [short] The head of the list of bot commands that opens on / in the message box. Written in capitals.
chat_commands_matching: The head of the list of bot commands while one is typed after /. {query} is what's typed (bold, after the /). Written in capitals.
chat_copy_link: [short] An item of a message's menu.
chat_cursor_edit: [short] A hint by a message the keyboard is on: the key that edits it. {key} is the key (e), drawn as a key; edit is a verb.
chat_cursor_reply: [short] A hint by a message the keyboard is on: the key that replies to it. {key} is the key (r), drawn as a key; reply is a verb.
chat_day_today_at: Beside the author's name on a message of today. {time} is the time, e.g. 9:14 AM.
chat_delete_confirm: The question before a message is deleted.
chat_delete_confirm_button: [short] The button that deletes a message, under chat_delete_confirm. A verb.
chat_delete_message: [short] A button and a menu item of a message. A verb.
chat_drop_files: Over a chat while files are dragged over it.
chat_edit_cancel: [short] The × over the message box while editing a message.
chat_edit_keys: Over the message box while the user edits a message: what the keys do. Esc and Enter are the keys' names: write them as your language names them.
chat_edit_message: [short] A button and a menu item of the user's own message. A verb.
chat_edit_placeholder: In the empty message box while editing a message.
chat_edit_save: [short] The button that saves an edited message. A verb.
chat_edit_title: Over the message box while the user edits one of their messages.
chat_emoji_matching: The head of the list of emoji while a name is typed after :. {query} is what's typed (bold). Written in capitals.
chat_emoji_suggestions: Read by screen readers: the list of emoji that opens on : in the message box.
chat_emoji_unknown: Stands in for a custom emoji whose name isn't known: its image's tooltip and screen-reader text, and the text where it has no image. Shown between colons, as an emoji's code is (:emoji:).
chat_ephemeral_dismiss: [short] After chat_ephemeral_note: removes the bot's message. A verb.
chat_ephemeral_note: Under a bot's message that only the reader sees.
chat_file_remove: Read by screen readers: the × on a file waiting to be sent. {name} is the file's name.
chat_file_spoiler_label: Read by screen readers: the eye on a file waiting to be sent, which hides it as a spoiler. {name} is the file's name.
chat_file_spoiler_mark: [short] The tooltip of the eye on a file waiting to be sent.
chat_file_spoiler_remove: [short] The tooltip of the eye on a file marked as a spoiler.
chat_file_unnamed: The name shown for a file in a bot's message when the bot gave it none.
chat_input_placeholder_room: In a room's empty message box. {room} is the room's name, written after #. Message is a verb here: write to the room.
chat_interaction_failed: Under a bot's message, command or form, when what was pressed or sent failed.
chat_interaction_no_response: Under a bot's message, command or form, when the bot didn't answer in time.
chat_interaction_used: Above a bot's answer: who used the bot (bold), and what they used: its command, written /name, or the bot's name when they pressed a button or picked from a menu.
chat_interaction_waiting: Read by screen readers: dots that show while a bot answers a command.
chat_jump_newest: The tooltip of the arrow that scrolls a chat down to its newest message.
chat_jump_newest_count: Read by screen readers: the arrow that scrolls a chat down to its newest message, and how many messages are new.
chat_link_direct_message: [short] The chip of a link to a message, in a message's text, when that message is in a direct message (in place of its room's name).
chat_link_space_unknown: The tooltip of a link to a message, in a message's text, when its Space isn't one the reader is in: Unknown Space › #room.
chat_list_load_failed: In place of a chat's messages, when they didn't load.
chat_list_newer_below: At the bottom of a chat's messages, when newer ones are still to load.
chat_list_retry: [short] The button under chat_list_load_failed. A verb.
chat_media_load_failed: In place of a picture or video of a message that didn't load.
chat_member_menu: Read by screen readers: the menu of a message's author, from a right-click on their picture. A noun.
chat_members_matching: The head of the list of members while a name is typed after @. {query} is what's typed (bold). Written in capitals.
chat_mention_notice_dismiss: [short] Read by screen readers: the × that takes a mention's notice away. A verb.
chat_mention_notice_head: The top line of a mention's notice, who and where: Ana in #general · Alpha. {author} is the author's name; place is dm for a direct message, otherwise {name} is the room and its Space (#general · Alpha) or the group's name. <who> holds the author's name, drawn in bold and never cut; <where> holds where, drawn fainter and cut short with … when the line is too long. Keep each tag's words together.
chat_mention_notices_label: Read by screen readers: the place at the top of the window where the notices of mentions show.
chat_mention_suggestions: Read by screen readers: the list of members that opens on @ in the message box.
chat_message_dismiss: [short] A button by a message that couldn't be sent: removes it. A verb.
chat_message_edited: After a message's text, in brackets: (edited). An adjective: the message was edited.
chat_message_edited_ago: After a message's text, in brackets: (edited 5 minutes ago). {time} is when, e.g. just now, 5 minutes ago.
chat_message_menu: Read by screen readers: a message's menu. A noun.
chat_message_more: [short] The button by a message that opens its menu.
chat_message_retry: [short] A button by a message that couldn't be sent: sends it again. A verb.
chat_message_show_less: [short] Under a long message shown whole: shortens it again.
chat_message_show_more: [short] Under a long message in the search results, pins or a thread: shows the rest of it.
chat_modal_cancel: [short] A button of a form a bot opened: closes it without sending. A verb.
chat_modal_submit: [short] A button of a form a bot opened: sends it. A verb.
chat_open_image: Read by screen readers: a picture in a bot's message, which opens it bigger.
chat_picker_all: The tooltip of the message box's smiley button, which opens its picker.
chat_picker_emoji: [short] A tab of the message box's picker, and the tooltip of its button while editing a message.
chat_picker_gifs: [short] A tab of the message box's picker.
chat_picker_stickers: [short] A tab of the message box's picker.
chat_picker_tabs: Read by screen readers: the tabs of the message box's picker (emoji, GIFs, stickers).
chat_pin: [short] An item of a message's menu. A verb.
chat_pin_failed: A notice when pinning a message failed.
chat_pin_notice: A notice among a chat's messages. {name} pinned a message (bold); <message> links to the message pinned, <pins> opens the chat's pinned messages. place is chat for a direct message or group, room for a Space's room.
chat_pins_empty: The list of pinned messages, empty. place is chat for a direct message or group, room for a Space's room.
chat_pins_jump: [short] A button on a pinned message: goes to it in the chat. A verb.
chat_pins_load_failed: In the list of pinned messages, when it didn't load.
chat_pins_loading: The list of pinned messages, while it loads.
chat_pins_title: [short] The button over a chat that opens its pinned messages, and the list's title.
chat_quote_deleted: Above a reply, in place of the message it replied to, which is gone.
chat_quote_without_text: In place of a message's text, where it has none to show (only files, a sticker or buttons): a reply's quote, a mention's notice.
chat_react_with: The tooltip of a quick reaction on a message. {emoji} is the emoji itself (👍).
chat_reaction_add: [short] The button by a message that opens the emoji picker to react with.
chat_reactions: [short] An item of a message's menu: who reacted with what.
chat_reactions_more: [short] The smiley at the end of a message menu's row of reactions: opens the emoji picker.
chat_recording: Over the message box, and in a chat's row. {count} is how many people are recording; {names} is the name, or the two names joined as a list (Ana and Ben).
chat_recording_cancel: [short] The button that throws away the voice note being recorded.
chat_recording_on: In the message box while a voice note is being recorded.
chat_recording_pause: [short] The button that pauses recording a voice note.
chat_recording_paused: In the message box while recording a voice note is paused.
chat_recording_resume: [short] The button that goes on recording a paused voice note.
chat_recording_send: [short] The button that sends the voice note being recorded.
chat_recording_start: [short] The microphone button of the empty message box.
chat_region_label: Read by screen readers: the part of the window with a chat's messages and its message box. A noun.
chat_reply: [short] A button and a menu item of a message. A verb.
chat_reply_cancel: [short] The × over the message box while a reply is written.
chat_reply_mention_label: Read by screen readers: the switch over the message box that makes a reply mention whom it replies to. {name} is their name. A verb.
chat_reply_mention_off: [short] The reply's mention switch, off. Written in capitals.
chat_reply_mention_off_hint: The tooltip of the reply's mention switch, while it's off. {name} is whom the reply answers.
chat_reply_mention_on: [short] The reply's mention switch, on: the reply mentions whom it answers. Written in capitals.
chat_reply_mention_on_hint: The tooltip of the reply's mention switch, while it's on. {name} is whom the reply answers.
chat_reply_to: Over the message box, while a reply is written. own is yes when it replies to the user's own message; {name} is whom it replies to (bold).
chat_room_suggestions: Read by screen readers: the list of rooms that opens on # in the message box.
chat_room_unknown: A room's name where it can't be shown (a room the reader can't see, or one that's gone), written after # as a room's mention: #unknown.
chat_rooms_matching: The head of the list of rooms while a name is typed after #. {query} is what's typed (bold). Written in capitals.
chat_search_clear: Read by screen readers: the × in the search box.
chat_search_close: Read by screen readers: the × over the search's results.
chat_search_date_takes: A search's error. {filter} is the search's filter typed (before, after or during), kept as is; {example} is today's date as the search takes it (2026-11-24).
chat_search_direct_message: Over a result of the search everywhere: it's in a direct message this app doesn't know.
chat_search_everywhere_filters: The search everywhere's error when a filter of one Space or chat is typed. from:, mentions: and in: are typed as they are: keep them.
chat_search_everywhere_label: Read by screen readers: the search box of the friends view.
chat_search_everywhere_placeholder: [short] In the empty search box of the friends view, which searches every Space and chat.
chat_search_failed: In the search's results, when it failed.
chat_search_filter_after: Beside the search's after: filter, in its suggestions: what it finds.
chat_search_filter_before: Beside the search's before: filter, in its suggestions. {date} is today's date as the search takes it (2026-11-24).
chat_search_filter_during: Beside the search's during: filter, in its suggestions: what it finds.
chat_search_filter_from: Beside the search's from: filter, in its suggestions: what it finds.
chat_search_filter_has: Beside the search's has: filter, in its suggestions: what it takes. The words are typed as they are after has: (has:link): keep them, and translate only the or.
chat_search_filter_in: Beside the search's in: filter, in its suggestions: what it finds.
chat_search_filter_mentions: Beside the search's mentions: filter, in its suggestions: what it finds.
chat_search_filter_pinned: Beside the search's pinned: filter, in its suggestions. true and false are typed as they are (pinned:true): keep them.
chat_search_has_takes: A search's error. has: is the search's filter, typed as is: keep it. {values} lists what it takes (link, embed, file…), which are typed as they are too.
chat_search_label: Read by screen readers: the search box over a chat.
chat_search_loading: [short] The button under the search's results while more load.
chat_search_more: [short] The button under the search's results that loads more.
chat_search_no_member: A search's error, in the results. {name} is the name typed after from: or mentions:.
chat_search_no_results: The search's results, when it found nothing.
chat_search_no_room: A search's error, in the results. {name} is the room typed after in:.
chat_search_pinned_takes: A search's error. pinned:, true and false are typed as they are in the search: keep them.
chat_search_placeholder: [short] In the empty search box over a chat. A verb.
chat_search_results: [short] The head of the search's results: how many messages were found.
chat_search_results_label: Read by screen readers: the panel under the search box, while it shows results.
chat_search_results_over: [short] The head of the search's results, when 1,000 messages or more were found: {count} is 1,000.
chat_search_results_some: [short] The head of the search everywhere's results, which shows the newest: {shown} is how many show, {count} how many were found.
chat_search_results_some_over: [short] The head of the search everywhere's results, when 1,000 messages or more were found: {shown} is how many show; {count} is 1,000.
chat_search_room_unknown: A search result's room, when it can't be named (gone, or one the reader can't see). Written as a room's name is, with no spaces.
chat_search_searching: The head of the search's results while it searches.
chat_search_space_unknown: Over a result of the search everywhere: its Space, when it can't be named. After the room: general · Space.
chat_search_suggestions: Read by screen readers: the panel under the search box, while it suggests filters.
chat_search_title: [short] The head of the search's results when it failed. A noun.
chat_search_today: Beside today's date in the search's suggestions for before:, after: and during:.
chat_select_no_results: A bot's menu, when nothing matches the search.
chat_select_options: Read by screen readers: the list of a bot's menu, when the bot gave it no name.
chat_select_placeholder: A bot's menu in a message, before anything is chosen.
chat_select_search: [short] The search field of a bot's menu of members, roles or rooms. A verb.
chat_send: [short] The button that sends the message. A verb.
chat_send_failed: A notice when a message couldn't be sent.
chat_sticker_alt: Read by screen readers: a sticker sent as a message.
chat_sticker_deleted: In place of a sticker that's gone.
chat_thread_from: Under the title of a message's thread: who wrote the message. {name} is their name.
chat_thread_load_failed: In a message's thread, when it didn't load.
chat_thread_placeholder: In the empty message box of a thread.
chat_thread_reply_to: Read by screen readers: the reply button on a message of a thread. {name} wrote it.
chat_thread_title: The title of the panel of a message's replies.
chat_thread_view: [short] An item of a message's menu: opens the replies to it.
chat_time_just_now: How long ago a message was edited, under 45 seconds: (edited just now). Fills {time} in chat_message_edited_ago.
chat_typing: Over the message box, and in a chat's row. {count} is how many people are typing; {names} is the name, or the two names joined as a list (Ana and Ben).
chat_typing_and_recording: A chat's row in the sidebar: who's typing there ({typing}, chat_typing), then who's recording a voice note ({recording}, chat_recording).
chat_typing_still: A chat's row in the sidebar: who's typing there ({typing} is chat_typing), still going.
chat_unpin: [short] The × on a pinned message in the list of pins, and the item of a message's menu.
chat_unpin_failed: A notice when unpinning a message failed.
chat_unread_divider: The line over the first unread message of a chat.
chat_upload_cancel: [short] The button under a message's files while they're sent: stops sending it. A verb.
chat_upload_cancel_label: Read by screen readers: the Cancel button under a message's files while they're sent.
chat_upload_file: In place of a file of a message while it's sent. {name} is the file's name.
chat_upload_progress: Under a message's file while it's sent, and in settings while a picture uploads. {percent} is how much is up, 0 to 100.
chat_upload_progress_files: Under a message's files while they're sent. {current} is which file is going up, {total} how many there are, {percent} how much of them all is up (0 to 100).
chat_upload_sent_before_cancel: A notice after Cancel on a message being sent, when it was too late.
chat_video_loading: Over a message's video while it loads.
chat_voice_note_deleted: In place of a voice note that's gone.
chat_voice_note_send_failed: A notice when a voice note couldn't be sent.
chat_voice_note_sending: Under a voice note while it's being sent.
chat_voice_room: Read by screen readers: the speaker icon of a voice room in the list of rooms.
emoji_activities: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
emoji_animals: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
emoji_flags: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
emoji_food: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
emoji_objects: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
emoji_people: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
emoji_smileys: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
emoji_symbols: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
emoji_travel: [short] An emoji category, as emoji-datasource names it: a tab's tooltip in the emoji picker, and the heading above its emojis.
format_size_bytes: [short] A file's size under a kilobyte. {size} is the number, written in the language's digits.
format_size_kb: [short] A file's size in kilobytes, e.g. 12.5 KB. Use your language's unit (French: Ko).
format_size_mb: [short] A file's size in megabytes, e.g. 3.25 MB. Use your language's unit (French: Mo).
keys_alt: [short] The Alt key's name, on a key cap in the keyboard shortcuts sheet (not on macOS, which shows ⌥).
keys_alt_click: [short] A click with the Alt key held, in a menu item's shortcut hint (not on macOS).
keys_anything: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the shortcut that opens the quick switcher, to go anywhere by typing its name.
keys_chat_step: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys that go to the next or the previous open chat.
keys_ctrl: [short] The Control key's name, as the keyboard writes it, on a key cap (not on macOS, which shows ⌘). German: Strg.
keys_ctrl_click: [short] A click with the Control key held, in a menu item's shortcut hint (not on macOS). German: Strg-Klick.
keys_ctrl_shift_with: [short] A shortcut: Control, Shift and a letter, as a tooltip or a key cap writes it. {key} is the letter, e.g. M.
keys_ctrl_with: [short] A shortcut: Control and a letter, as a tooltip or a key cap writes it. {key} is the letter, e.g. K.
keys_edit: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that edits the user's own message under the cursor.
keys_either: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet, between two sets of key caps that do the same: <single> holds the single key (keyboard navigation), <shortcut> the shortcut with a modifier. The tags hold no words: keep both, in the order your language puts them.
keys_esc: [short] The Escape key's name, on a key cap.
keys_go_to: [short] A heading of the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys that go somewhere.
keys_leave_box: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that leaves the message box, to move around with single keys.
keys_mac_click: [short] A click with a key held, on macOS, in a menu item's shortcut hint. {key} is the key's symbol, ⌘ or ⌥.
keys_mark: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that shows a letter on each row and message, typed to jump there.
keys_message_step: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys that move to the next or the previous message.
keys_messages: [short] A heading of the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys for a chat's messages.
keys_newest: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that goes to the newest message.
keys_next_unread: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys that go to the next chat with unread messages.
keys_open_chat: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the digits that open the open chats 1 to 8, and 9 the last one.
keys_reply: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that replies to the message under the cursor. A verb.
keys_sheet_again: The last line of the keyboard shortcuts sheet: <single> holds the ? key cap, <shortcut> the ⌘/ or Ctrl / key caps. The tags hold no words: keep both.
keys_sheet_close: The keyboard shortcuts sheet's close button, for a screen reader.
keys_sheet_note_off: Under the keyboard shortcuts sheet's title, while keyboard navigation is off. Settings and Appearance are the names of Settings and its Appearance page.
keys_sheet_note_on: Under the keyboard shortcuts sheet's title, while keyboard navigation is on. Esc is the Escape key.
keys_shift: [short] The Shift key's name, on a key cap (not on macOS, which shows ⇧).
keys_write: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that goes back to writing in the message box.
media_bot_badge: [short] A badge after a bot's name on a bot's invite card. English writes it in capitals.
media_bot_invite_add: Button on the card a bot's invite link shows in a message: picks a Space to add the bot to.
media_bot_invite_title: Heading of the card a bot's invite link shows in a message.
media_crop_apply: [short] Button of the crop dialog: crops the picture and uses it. Verb.
media_crop_change: [short] Button of the crop dialog: picks another picture.
media_crop_choose: In the crop dialog's empty drop area, before a picture is picked.
media_crop_formats: Under the crop dialog's drop area: the pictures it takes, and how large. Write MB as your language does (French: Mo).
media_crop_hint: Above the picture in the crop dialog: how to move it in the frame and zoom it.
media_crop_processing: [short] The crop dialog's Apply button while the cropped picture is being made.
media_crop_title: Title of the dialog that crops a picture before it's uploaded (an avatar, a banner, an emoji), when what opened it gave none.
media_crop_zoom: The crop dialog's zoom slider, for a screen reader. Noun.
media_edited_marker: After a message's text, in small type: the note that it was edited. {edited} is the chat's words for it, e.g. edited 3:02 PM. Write the brackets as your language does.
media_emoji_categories: Names the emoji picker's row of category tabs, for a screen reader.
media_emoji_load_failed: Tooltip on a custom emoji's name, which shows in its place when its picture couldn't load.
media_emoji_picker: Names the emoji picker's popover, for a screen reader.
media_emoji_recent: [short] The emoji picker's first tab (its tooltip) and the heading above it: the emojis used lately.
media_emoji_search: [short] The emoji picker's search field: its placeholder, and its name for a screen reader.
media_gif_attribution: Under the GIF picker's results: KLIPY's attribution, which its guidelines require. Keep KLIPY as it is.
media_gif_empty: In the GIF picker when KLIPY gives no GIF for the search.
media_gif_load_failed: In the GIF picker when KLIPY couldn't be reached, above a Try again button.
media_gif_picker: The GIF picker's heading, and its name for a screen reader.
media_gif_retry: [short] Button in the GIF picker after a failure: asks KLIPY for the GIFs again.
media_gif_search: [short] The GIF picker's search placeholder, and its name for a screen reader. KLIPY's attribution guidelines require it to name KLIPY: keep KLIPY as it is.
media_gif_send: A GIF in the picker, for a screen reader: pressing it sends it. {title} is the GIF's title, as KLIPY gives it.
media_gif_send_untitled: A GIF without a title in the picker, for a screen reader: pressing it sends it.
media_gif_timeout: In the GIF picker when KLIPY didn't answer in time, above a Try again button.
media_image: The image viewer's title, for a screen reader, when the image has no description.
media_image_close: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's close button. Esc in brackets is the key that does the same: write it as your language's keyboards do.
media_image_named: The image viewer's title, for a screen reader. {name} is the image's description or its file's name.
media_image_reset: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's button that puts the image back as it opened. (0) is the key that does the same.
media_image_rotate_left: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's button that turns the image a quarter turn anticlockwise. ([) is the key that does the same.
media_image_rotate_right: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's button that turns the image a quarter turn clockwise. (]) is the key that does the same.
media_image_zoom_in: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's zoom-in button. (+) is the key that does the same.
media_image_zoom_out: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's zoom-out button. (-) is the key that does the same.
media_invite_join: [short] Button on the card an invite link shows in a message: joins the Space. Verb.
media_invite_join_failed: Under an invite's card when joining failed and the API gave no reason.
media_invite_joined: On an invite's card, in place of its Join button, once the person has joined the Space.
media_invite_joining: [short] The invite card's Join button while the request is on its way.
media_invite_members: Under the Space's name on an invite's card: how many members the Space has.
media_invite_title: Heading of the card an invite link shows in a message.
media_link_direct_message: In the card a link to a message shows: in place of the conversation's name, for one with no name.
media_link_loading: In the card a link to a message shows, while that message loads.
media_link_unknown_room: In the card a link to a message shows: in place of the name of a room the app doesn't know. Written as a room's name is, lowercase with hyphens.
media_now_playing: Names, for a screen reader, the bar at the bottom of the sidebar that shows the voice note playing.
media_open_image: For a screen reader: a link preview's image, which opens in the image viewer when pressed.
media_pause: [short] A player's button, for a screen reader: pauses the voice note or audio file playing. Verb.
media_picker_no_results: In the emoji and sticker pickers when the search finds nothing. {query} is what the person typed.
media_play: [short] A player's button, for a screen reader: plays the voice note, audio file or video. Verb.
media_play_named: A video's play button, for a screen reader. {title} is the video's title, as its page gives it.
media_playback_rate: [short] The text of a player's speed button: {rate} times the normal speed, e.g. 1.5x.
media_playback_speed: A player's speed button, for a screen reader. {rate} is the speed, e.g. 1.5: the x after it means times.
media_reaction_add: [short] Tooltip of the button after a message's reactions, and its name for a screen reader: opens the emoji picker to react.
media_reactions_title: Title of the dialog that shows who reacted to a message, and the name of its list of reactions for a screen reader.
media_reactions_who: Names, for a screen reader, the list of the people who reacted with the chosen emoji.
media_reactor_unknown: In place of a person's name while the app can't tell who they are: someone who reacted to a message, or who banned someone.
media_search_clear: The × in a picker's search field, for a screen reader: empties the field. Verb.
media_search_results: [short] Heading above the emoji picker's search results.
media_seek: Names a player's progress line, for a screen reader: pressing it, or the arrow keys, moves through the audio. Verb.
media_seek_position: Read out on a player's progress line by a screen reader. {position} is how far it has played and {duration} how long it is, both as a clock, e.g. 1:05.
media_spoiler: [short] On the cover over a spoiler, which a click takes away. English writes it in capitals.
media_sticker: A sticker with no name, for a screen reader. Noun.
media_sticker_empty: In the sticker picker when no Space of the person's has stickers.
media_sticker_picker: Names the sticker picker's popover, for a screen reader.
media_sticker_search: [short] The sticker picker's search field: its placeholder, and its name for a screen reader.
media_stop: [short] A button of the voice note bar, for a screen reader: stops the voice note and closes the bar. Verb.
media_text_preview_contents: Names the box that holds a text file's contents, for a screen reader. {filename} is the file's name.
media_text_preview_copied: [short] Beside the copy button of a text file's preview for a moment, once the text is copied.
media_text_preview_copy: [short] Tooltip of the copy button of a text file's preview. Verb.
media_text_preview_copy_label: The copy button of a text file's preview, for a screen reader: copies the file's text.
media_text_preview_description: Under a text file's name, in the dialog that shows its contents: they can be read and copied, not changed.
media_text_preview_failed: In a text file's preview dialog when the file couldn't be read.
media_text_preview_loading: In a text file's preview dialog while the file is read.
media_text_preview_truncated: Under a long text file's preview. {size} is how much of it shows, e.g. 1 MB.
public_app_connecting: Beside a spinner while the app connects, before anything else shows.
public_app_open_chat_failed: A notice when a direct message with someone couldn't be opened or started.
public_app_resize_sidebar: Screen reader name of the sidebar's right edge, which is dragged (or moved with the arrow keys) to make the sidebar wider or narrower.
public_download_other_systems: Under the download button. duvet.chat is the website's address: keep it as it is.
public_download_page_title: The browser tab's title of the download page. Duvet is the app's name.
public_download_title: Heading of the download page (a verb: get the app). Duvet is the app's name.
public_download_windows: [short] The download page's button: the installer for Windows.
public_invite_bad_link: The invite link opened is broken: it has no invite code, or a wrong one.
public_invite_go_back: [short] A button on an invite that can't be used: goes back to the start page.
public_invite_invited: <line>…</line> is the small line over the Space's name; <name>{space}</name> is the name, drawn as the card's heading. Keep both tags; either may come first. Put every word inside one of them: words outside the tags show unstyled between the line and the heading.
public_invite_join: [short] The invite card's button: join the Space (a verb).
public_invite_join_failed: Shown on the invite card when joining the Space failed.
public_invite_joining: [short] The invite card's button while the Space is being joined.
public_invite_loading: Beside a spinner while the invite is looked up.
public_invite_members: On the invite card: how many members the Space has, capitalised as a label. # is the number.
public_invite_not_now: [short] The invite card's last button: leave without joining.
public_invite_sign_in: [short] The invite card's button when signed out: sign in, then join the Space.
public_invite_sign_in_note: On the invite card when signed out, over the button "Sign in to join".
public_invite_unavailable: Heading when an invite link can't be used: it's wrong, expired or used up.
public_settings_window_title: The title of the Settings window. Duvet is the app's name.
public_space_settings_window_title: The title of a Space's settings window, before the Space's name is known.
public_space_settings_window_title_named: The title of a Space's settings window. {space} is the Space's name, as its people wrote it.
settings_language_note: Under the language picker in Settings › Appearance. Messages are what people send each other: the app never translates them.
settings_language_system: [short] The picker's first choice: follow the computer's language. {language} is that language's name in itself, e.g. Español.
shell_badge_silly: [short] A badge's name, shown on a profile when hovering its picture.
shell_call_history: [short] The sidebar's button and the panel that list the user's calls. A noun.
shell_call_untitled: A call's name when the app can't tell whose it is.
shell_cancel: [short] A button that closes a dialog without doing anything.
shell_cant_speak: The microphone button's tooltip in a voice room where the user may not speak.
shell_category_delete: [short] A menu item of a category of rooms.
shell_category_edit: [short] A menu item of a category of rooms: opens its settings.
shell_chat_dm_untitled: A direct message's name while the other person's name isn't known.
shell_chat_group_untitled: A group chat's name while it has none.
shell_chat_kind_dm: Under a chat's name: it's a direct message, a chat with one person.
shell_chat_kind_group: Under a chat's name: it's a group, a chat with several people.
shell_chats: [short] The sidebar's section of direct messages and groups, and its filter's choice. A noun.
shell_close: [short] A dialog's close button (×), for a screen reader.
shell_close_all_tabs: [short] A tab's menu item: closes every tab of the pane.
shell_close_chat: An open chat's close button (×) in the sidebar, for a screen reader. {title} is the chat's name.
shell_close_other_tabs: [short] A tab's menu item: closes every tab of the pane but this one.
shell_close_tab: [short] A tab's menu item, and its × button for a screen reader: closes the tab.
shell_close_tabs_left: [short] A tab's menu item: closes the tabs before this one in the tab strip (to its left in English).
shell_close_tabs_right: [short] A tab's menu item: closes the tabs after this one in the tab strip (to its right in English).
shell_copy_image_failed: A notice after the right-click menu's Copy image failed.
shell_deafen: [short] The button that stops all sound from a call or voice room. A verb.
shell_delete: [short] The button that deletes a room, in the dialog that asks first.
shell_dismiss: [short] A notice's close button (×), for a screen reader.
shell_empty_pane_hint: In a pane with no chat open. <key> holds the shortcut that opens the quick switcher (⌘K or Ctrl K), drawn as a key cap.
shell_empty_pane_recent: The list of the user's latest chats in an empty pane, for a screen reader.
shell_empty_pane_title: The heading of a pane with no chat open.
shell_filter_all: [short] A choice of the sidebar's switch: show chats and Spaces.
shell_filter_all_title: The tooltip of the sidebar switch's All.
shell_filter_chats_title: The tooltip of the sidebar switch's Chats.
shell_filter_spaces_title: The tooltip of the sidebar switch's Spaces.
shell_flag_staff: [short] An account flag's name, in the staff's flags and badges sheet: the person works on Duvet.
shell_friend_requests: The friend requests waiting, on the Friends row's count, for a screen reader and as its tooltip.
shell_friends: [short] The Friends page's name: its row in the sidebar and its tab.
shell_group_call_untitled: A group call's name while its group has none.
shell_group_members: Under a group chat's name: how many people are in it.
shell_hide_sidebar: [short] The button (and its tooltip) that hides the sidebar.
shell_in_a_call: Under a chat's name in the sidebar while the user is in its call.
shell_in_voice: [short] Beside a voice room or a Space: how many people are in its voice rooms.
shell_invite_people: [short] Opens the dialog that makes an invite link to a Space.
shell_join_or_create_space: A button in the sidebar's Spaces section, and its tooltip.
shell_mark_all_read: [short] A Space's menu item: marks every room of it read.
shell_member_menu: The menu of a person in a voice room, for a screen reader.
shell_mentions: A count chip's name for a screen reader: the mentions of the user waiting in a chat, a room or a Space.
shell_menu_copy: [short] An item of the right-click menu on selected text.
shell_menu_copy_image: [short] An item of the right-click menu on a picture.
shell_menu_copy_image_link: [short] An item of the right-click menu on a picture: copies its address.
shell_menu_copy_link: [short] An item of the right-click menu on a link: copies its address.
shell_menu_copy_video_link: [short] An item of the right-click menu on a video: copies its address.
shell_menu_devtools: [short] An item of the right-click menu in a development build. DevTools is the browser's developer tools.
shell_menu_for_developer: The name of the right-click menu that holds only Open DevTools, for a screen reader.
shell_menu_for_image: The name of the right-click menu on a picture, for a screen reader.
shell_menu_for_link: The name of the right-click menu on a link, for a screen reader.
shell_menu_for_selection: The name of the right-click menu on selected text, for a screen reader.
shell_menu_for_video: The name of the right-click menu on a video, for a screen reader.
shell_menu_open_image: [short] An item of the right-click menu on a picture: opens it in the browser.
shell_menu_open_link: [short] An item of the right-click menu on a link: opens it in the browser.
shell_menu_open_video: [short] An item of the right-click menu on a video: opens it in the browser.
shell_menu_quote: [short] An item of the right-click menu on selected text of a message: quotes it in a reply.
shell_menu_search: [short] An item of the right-click menu on selected text. {text} is the selected text, cut short.
shell_more: [short] The pane's ⋯ menu button, for a screen reader.
shell_more_chats: [short] The row under the sidebar's latest chats that shows the rest of them.
shell_mute: [short] The microphone button: a press mutes it. A verb.
shell_new_chat: [short] The sidebar's button (and its tooltip) that starts a direct message or a group.
shell_new_tab: [short] A tab with no chat in it, and the button (and its tooltip) that opens one.
shell_no_other_tabs: [short] The only item of the Split with menu when no other tab is open.
shell_nothing_unread: A notice after the key for the next unread chat found none.
shell_notifications: [short] A menu item that opens the choice of what notifies the user.
shell_notifications_off: A bell icon's name beside a chat that doesn't notify, for a screen reader.
shell_notify_all: [short] A choice of the Notifications menu: notify of every message.
shell_notify_change_failed: A notice after a change of the Notifications menu failed.
shell_notify_default: [short] A choice of the Notifications menu: follow the Space's default, whose level is in brackets.
shell_notify_mentions: [short] A choice of the Notifications menu: notify only when the user is mentioned.
shell_notify_nothing: [short] A choice of the Notifications menu: never notify.
shell_notify_permission_ask: In the web app, a bar that asks to turn on the browser's notifications.
shell_notify_permission_label: The bar that asks to turn on notifications, for a screen reader.
shell_notify_permission_turn_on: [short] The button of the bar that asks to turn on notifications.
shell_now: The sidebar's section of what's going on now (calls, requests, voice rooms, friends online), for a screen reader.
shell_now_accept: [short] The tooltip of a ✓ button that accepts a friend request or an invite.
shell_now_accept_invite: The ✓ button of a team invite, for a screen reader. {team} is the team's name.
shell_now_accept_invite_failed: A notice after accepting a team invite failed.
shell_now_accept_request: The ✓ button of a friend request, for a screen reader. {name} is who sent it.
shell_now_accept_request_failed: A notice after accepting a friend request failed.
shell_now_asking: The list of what asks the user something (calls to join, requests, invites), for a screen reader.
shell_now_busiest_only: [short] The row under the busiest voice rooms that hides the others again.
shell_now_call_elsewhere: Under a call's name: the user is calling from another device, waiting for an answer.
shell_now_call_going_on: Under a call's name: a call is going on that the user can join.
shell_now_call_people: The faces of a call's people, for a screen reader: how many are in it.
shell_now_decline: [short] The tooltip of an × button that declines a friend request or an invite.
shell_now_decline_invite: The × button of a team invite, for a screen reader. {team} is the team's name.
shell_now_decline_invite_failed: A notice after declining a team invite failed.
shell_now_decline_request: The × button of a friend request, for a screen reader. {name} is who sent it.
shell_now_decline_request_failed: A notice after declining a friend request failed.
shell_now_in_voice: [short] A heading of the sidebar's Now section: the voice rooms people are in.
shell_now_invite_accepted: A notice after the user accepted a team invite.
shell_now_join: [short] The button that joins a call going on. A verb.
shell_now_join_call: The Join button of a call, for a screen reader. {name} is the group's or the person's name.
shell_now_message_friend: An online friend's face, for a screen reader: a press opens the direct message with them. {name} is the friend's name.
shell_now_message_friend_doing: An online friend's row, for a screen reader. {name} is the friend's name, {activity} the game or the song, as their app reports it.
shell_now_more_friends: The +N button after the online friends' faces, for a screen reader.
shell_now_more_online: [short] The tooltip of the +N button after the online friends' faces.
shell_now_more_rooms: [short] The row under the busiest voice rooms that shows the others.
shell_now_moving: The heading of files being moved between storages. own: the user's own files; space: a Space's, {owner} being its name; other: a Space whose name isn't known.
shell_now_moving_count: Files being moved: how many are done, of how many.
shell_now_moving_percent: [short] How far files being moved between storages have got. {percent} is a whole number from 0 to 100; write the percent sign as your language does (French: {percent} %).
shell_now_moving_to: Files being moved: where to ({target}, a storage's name), how many are done, of how many.
shell_now_online_friends: [short] A heading of the sidebar's Now section: the user's friends who are online.
shell_now_open_call: A call's row, for a screen reader: a press opens its chat. {name} is the group's or the person's name.
shell_now_room_in_space: A voice room's tooltip. {room} is the room's name, {space} the Space's.
shell_now_room_label: A voice room's row, for a screen reader: a press opens it. {room} is its name, {space} its Space's; live is screen while someone shares their screen, camera while someone has theirs on, else none.
shell_now_team_invite: Under a team's name: who invited the user to it. {name} is their name.
shell_now_wants_friends: Under a person's name: they sent the user a friend request.
shell_open_beside: [short] A chat's menu item: opens it in the pane beside.
shell_open_chats: The list of the open chats (tabs), for a screen reader.
shell_open_chats_empty: In the sidebar's Open section while no chat is open.
shell_open_room: [short] Shown in the tab strip while a room is dragged over it: dropping it opens it as a tab.
shell_open_section: [short] A heading of the sidebar: the chats open in the focused pane. An adjective.
shell_pane: A pane of the chat area, for a screen reader.
shell_pane_close: [short] A pane's menu item and × button: closes the pane.
shell_pane_content: The chat area of a pane, where a dragged room drops, for a screen reader.
shell_pane_resize: The handle between two panes, for a screen reader. Split is a noun: two panes side by side.
shell_people_count: How many people are in a voice room or a call.
shell_pin_to_top: [short] A chat's or a Space's menu item: keeps it at the top of the sidebar.
shell_pinned: A pin icon's name beside a pinned chat or Space, for a screen reader. An adjective.
shell_quiet_spaces: [short] The row that holds the Spaces with nothing new. {count} is how many there are.
shell_room_category: [short] The label of the create room dialog's category picker.
shell_room_category_none: [short] The category picker's choice for a room in no category.
shell_room_copy_id: [short] A room's or a category's menu item: copies its ID.
shell_room_create: [short] A Space's menu item, and the create room dialog's title and button.
shell_room_create_failed: A notice after creating a room failed.
shell_room_delete: [short] A room's menu item, and the title of the dialog that asks first.
shell_room_delete_failed: A notice after deleting a room failed.
shell_room_delete_question: The dialog before a room or a category is deleted. <b> holds the room's name after its #, drawn in bold.
shell_room_move_failed: A notice after moving a room in its Space failed.
shell_room_name: [short] The label of the create room dialog's name field.
shell_room_name_placeholder: The example in the create room dialog's name field: a room's name, lowercase with dashes.
shell_room_settings: [short] A room's menu item: opens its settings.
shell_room_start: At the top of a room's first messages. {room} is its name after its #.
shell_room_start_in_space: At the top of a room's first messages. {room} is its name after its #, {space} its Space's.
shell_room_type: [short] The label of the create room dialog's kind picker.
shell_room_type_category: [short] A choice of the create room dialog's kind: a category, which holds rooms.
shell_room_type_text: [short] A choice of the create room dialog's kind: a room for messages.
shell_room_type_voice: [short] A choice of the create room dialog's kind: a room people talk in.
shell_rooms_empty: Under a Space in the sidebar when it has no room the user can see.
shell_search_or_jump: The sidebar's search field, which opens the quick switcher.
shell_separate_split: [short] A tab's menu item: puts the panes side by side back into one.
shell_settings: [short] The button (and its tooltip) that opens Settings.
shell_show_fewer: [short] The row that hides the older chats again.
shell_show_sidebar: [short] The button (and its tooltip) that shows the sidebar again.
shell_sidebar: The sidebar, for a screen reader.
shell_sidebar_filter: The sidebar's All · Chats · Spaces switch, for a screen reader.
shell_space_fold: A Space's caret, for a screen reader: hides its rooms. {name} is the Space's name.
shell_space_leave: [short] The button of the dialog that asks before the user leaves a Space. A verb.
shell_space_leave_question: The dialog before the user leaves a Space. {name} is the Space's name.
shell_space_menu: [short] A Space's ⋯ menu, and its button's tooltip.
shell_space_options: A Space's ⋯ menu button, for a screen reader. {name} is the Space's name.
shell_space_settings: [short] A Space's menu item: opens its settings.
shell_space_unfold: A Space's caret, for a screen reader: shows its rooms. {name} is the Space's name.
shell_spaces: [short] The sidebar's section of Spaces, and its filter's choice.
shell_split_drop: [short] Shown while a chat is dragged over a pane: what a drop there does. zone is the pane's side (left, right, top, bottom) or its middle, which opens the chat in the pane.
shell_split_horizontally: [short] A pane's menu item: a new pane to the right.
shell_split_pair: The tab of two panes side by side, for a screen reader. {chats} is their chats' names as a list (Ana and #general).
shell_split_vertically: [short] A pane's menu item: a new pane below.
shell_split_with: [short] A tab's menu item, which opens the list of the other tabs to put beside it.
shell_split_with_chat: [short] A tab's menu item: opens the quick switcher to pick a chat to put beside it.
shell_switcher_empty: In the quick switcher when the user has no Space and no chat.
shell_switcher_help: The quick switcher's foot. ↑ ↓ are the arrow keys; Enter and Esc are keys' names.
shell_switcher_kind_friend: [short] Beside a friend's name in the quick switcher.
shell_switcher_kind_space: [short] Beside a Space's name in the quick switcher.
shell_switcher_no_match: In the quick switcher when nothing has a name like what was typed. {query} is what was typed.
shell_switcher_open: [short] Beside the quick switcher's chosen result: Enter opens it. A verb.
shell_switcher_placeholder: The quick switcher's search field, before anything is typed.
shell_switcher_results: The quick switcher's list, for a screen reader.
shell_switcher_search: The quick switcher's search field, for a screen reader.
shell_switcher_title: The quick switcher's title, for a screen reader.
shell_undeafen: [short] The button that brings back a call's sound. A verb.
shell_unknown_person: A person's name while the app doesn't know it: a message's author, someone in a voice room.
shell_unmute: [short] The microphone button while it's muted: a press turns it on. A verb.
shell_unpin: [short] A pinned chat's or Space's menu item. A verb.
shell_unread: A dot's name for a screen reader: the chat, the tab or the Space has unread messages. An adjective.
shell_unread_chats: A dot on the sidebar's switch, for a screen reader: some chats have unread messages.
shell_unread_rooms: A dot on the sidebar's switch, for a screen reader: some rooms have unread messages.
shell_update_download: [short] The title bar's button when a newer version is out that the app can't install itself.
shell_update_download_title: The tooltip of the title bar's Download update. {version} is the version, e.g. 1.2.0.
shell_update_ready_title: The tooltip of the title bar's Restart to update. {version} is the version, e.g. 1.2.0.
shell_update_restart: [short] The title bar's button when a newer version is downloaded and ready.
shell_update_restarting: [short] The title bar's button while the app restarts into the newer version.
shell_voice_camera_on: A camera icon's name beside someone in a voice room, for a screen reader.
shell_voice_connected: [short] A badge in a voice room's pane while the user is in it.
shell_voice_deafened: An icon's name beside someone in a voice room, for a screen reader: they hear nothing.
shell_voice_live: [short] A small red badge beside someone in a voice room who shares their screen. Uppercase on screen.
shell_voice_muted: An icon's name beside someone in a voice room, for a screen reader: their microphone is off.
shell_voice_sharing_screen: The LIVE badge's name, for a screen reader.
shell_window_close: The window's close button, for a screen reader.
shell_window_maximize: The window's maximize button, for a screen reader.
shell_window_minimize: The window's minimize button, for a screen reader.
status_change_failed: A notice after changing the user's status failed.
status_dnd: [short] A status the user can choose: no sounds, calls don't ring.
status_dnd_note: Under Do not disturb in the status menu.
status_menu_label: The profile row's button, which opens the status menu, for a screen reader. {name} is the user's name; status is the status they chose (dnd: Do not disturb).
status_online: [short] A status the user can choose.
status_online_note: Under Online in the status menu.
storage_files_select_all: [short] A checkbox over a storage's list of files: picks every file shown. A verb.
